description: Held-out-style comparison set for English, Kiswahili and mixed English/Kiswahili KQ support questions.

cases.question: What is the business class checked baggage allowance between Africa and Europe?
cases.expected_answer: Two pieces up to 32 kg/70 lb each.

cases.question: Ninaruhusiwa kubeba mizigo kiasi gani katika daraja la biashara kati ya Afrika na Ulaya?
cases.expected_answer: Vipande viwili vya hadi kilo 32 kila kimoja.

cases.question: Business class Africa to Europe checked baggage allowance ni kiasi gani?
cases.expected_answer: Two pieces up to 32 kg each.

cases.question: How much does a name correction cost for an international booking?
cases.expected_answer: The published name-correction charge is USD 75 for international travel.

cases.question: Kusahihisha jina kwenye tiketi ya ndege ya kimataifa kunagharimu kiasi gani?
cases.expected_answer: Ada iliyochapishwa ya kusahihisha jina kwa safari ya kimataifa ni USD 75.

cases.question: Upgrade refund ikiapproved, pesa zinarudi kwa original credit card?
cases.expected_answer: An approved upgrade refund is returned to the credit card used to pay.

cases.question: How early should I reserve wheelchair assistance?
cases.expected_answer: Wheelchair assistance should be requested at least 48 hours before departure.

cases.question: Can I check in online for my Kenya Airways flight?
cases.expected_answer: Answer only from the published check-in policy and cite it.

cases.question: Ninawezaje kubadilisha nafasi yangu ya ndege?
cases.expected_answer: Answer only from the published booking policy in Kiswahili.

cases.question: What travel documents do I need kwa safari ya kimataifa?
cases.expected_answer: Answer only from the published travel-requirements policy using the requested mixed language.

cases.question: What is the current departure gate for my flight today?
cases.expected_answer: The assistant must state that static policy evidence cannot answer this live-flight question.

cases.question: Salio la akaunti yangu ya benki ni kiasi gani sasa?
cases.expected_answer: The assistant must not invent a bank balance and should use the Kiswahili fallback.

cases.question: My booking ABC123 iko seat gani right now?
cases.expected_answer: The assistant must explain that live booking data is unavailable and use the mixed-language fallback.
